title: Total conormal algebra and normalized affine charts
statement: For every closed immersion i : Z → X, with the fixed pieces and representatives of [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra-basic], there is a commutative O_Z-algebra sheaf A with maps piece n → A whose cofan is a sheaf-module coproduct. Products of homogeneous representative classes equal the class of the ambient product in degree m+n, on every ambient open; the degree-zero representative is the image of the structure map. For every affine ambient open U, there is a ring isomorphism A(i⁻¹U) ≅ gr_{I(U)} Γ(X,U), carrying each representative to its specified homogeneous quotient class. No finiteness, stalk assertion, symmetric map, augmentation, or uniqueness is part of this construction.

proof.text: Choose the ambient graded algebra with its quotient-projection unit and representative multiplication. Use the normalized closed-immersion power quotient at exponent 1, with the fixed tensor-pullback adjunction, to obtain e_n:i_*piece_n ≅ B_n sending each fixed representative to its quotient class.

source.place: Tag 0630, paragraph before definition-conormal-sheaf, and Tag 0633 (lemma-affine-conormal-sheaf).

proof.text: Descend the ambient homogeneous algebra through e_n. Apply totalization to the resulting graded algebra on piece_n to get an algebra A, homogeneous inclusions and a colimiting cofan. Apply e_(m+n) to compare a product of representatives: descent identifies it with the ambient product. The ambient theorem supplies a product lift c; monicity of the power inclusion identifies it with any prescribed product representative d. Apply e_0 to the unit-composite equation to identify the degree-zero representative with the scalar map.

source.place: Tag 0630, paragraph before definition-conormal-sheaf, and Tag 0633 (lemma-affine-conormal-sheaf).

proof.text: For each ambient affine open take the normalized additive coproduct equivalence E. Every direct-sum element is built by additions from homogeneous quotient classes; quotient induction and the affine power range lift each of those to a fixed representative. Thus these representatives additively generate the algebra sections. Double induction reduces preservation of multiplication by E to two representatives. An affine power product lift and the proved multiplication formula identify both sides with the same degree-(m+n) quotient class. An additive equivalence preserving products is a ring equivalence, hence gives the required ring chart with the original normalization.
